attributes.bmi: >=30 kg/m2, or >=27 kg/m2 with >=1 weight-related comorbidity
attributes.qualifying_comorbidities: hypertension, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, cardiovascular disease
attributes.key_exclusions: diabetes mellitus; >5 kg weight change within 3 months; secondary/monogenic obesity; pancreatitis history; MTC or MEN-2 history; significant MDD or severe psychiatric disorder within 2 years
